dimensions.assessment: Affects electrical utilities operating on National Forest System lands and Bureau of Land Management lands, as well as federal land management agencies.
dimensions.evidence: special use permits or easements provided to electrical utilities permission to cut, remove, and sell trees

dimensions.assessment: Streamlines administrative procedures for vegetation removal and wildfire risk reduction without fundamentally altering public land ownership or utility operations.
dimensions.evidence: without requiring a separate timber sale, if that cutting and removal is consistent with... environmental laws

dimensions.assessment: Requires utilities to remit proceeds from any material sold (minus transportation costs) back to the federal government, though total financial amounts are unspecified.
dimensions.evidence: provide to the Secretary concerned any proceeds received from the sale, less any transportation costs incurred

dimensions.assessment: Modifies permitting rules for vegetation management specifically on National Forest System lands and BLM lands.
dimensions.evidence: special use permit or easement on covered Federal lands provided to an electrical utility

dimensions.assessment: Provides a permanent change to how special use permits and easements for electrical utilities are structured on covered federal lands.
dimensions.evidence: In any special use permit or easement on covered Federal lands provided to an electrical utility...

missing_information: The total volume of timber or financial proceeds expected to be generated from sales.
importance_detail.rationale: Permits the Forest Service and BLM to authorize electrical utilities to clear vegetation near power lines on federal lands without a separate timber sale, while returning net sale proceeds to the agencies.
